title: Everything Bossbar UW add-on
description: This Datapack adds Bossbars for every mob
body:
# What is this Project?

This Datapack is an Add-on for the [Ultimate Warden](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ultimate-warden) Datapack. While the original pack introduces terrifying new mechanics and challenges, this add-on enhances your entire world by adding dynamic, real-time Bossbars for every single mob in the game.

No more guessing how much health an enemy has left. Now you can see the status of every creature, from a simple zombie to the Ender Dragon!

# Key Features

- Universal Bossbars: Adds a clean, visual health bar at the top of your screen for every mob you encounter.

- Enhanced Combat Awareness: Perfect for intense fights, allowing you to track the damage of any enemy and adapt your strategy in real-time.

- Seamless Integration: Designed specifically to work flawlessly alongside the Ultimate Warden Datapack without causing lag or UI clutter.

- Passive & Hostile Support: Works on dangerous monsters, bosses, and even passive animals so you always know their exact HP.

## Requirements

[Ultimate Warden](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ultimate-warden) Datapack (This pack will not function properly without the core datapack installed).
